versions.content: Service Name Activate Task Asyn Syntax void Activate Task Asyn ( Task Type id ) Service ID [hex] 0x33 Sync/ Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) id The id of the task to be activated Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Asynchronous version of the Activate Task() function. Intended to be used for cross core task activation. Possible errors are not returned to the caller, but may be reported via error hooks. Available via Os.h
